1.

Heard Sri Dushyant Kumar, learned counsel for the applicants, Sri Indrajeet Singh Yadav, learned
A.G.A. for the State.

2.  This is an application under Section 528 of BNSS preferred by the applicant for quashing of the entire proceeding of Case No.6019 of 2019 (Smt. Anjula Maurya Vs. Ravi Prakash Maurya and others) under section 323, 504, 506, 498A IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, police station Phoolpur, District Prayagraj, pending in the court of Judicial Magistrate Court No.2, Allahabad as well as summoning order dated 05.03.2021 passed by Judicial Magistrate Court No.2 Allahabad, on the basis of compromise settled between the parties.

sentences.text: at page-75 onwards, reference whereof has been made in paragraph-11 of the affidavit.
Learned counsel for the applicants submits that a direction be given for verifying the compromise and till verification is done, no coercive action be taken.
4. Learned A.G.A. has no objection and submits that let an appropriate direction be issued to the court below to verify the compromise.

5. Considering the submissions of the parties, it is hereby provided that the applicants shall appear before the court below along with the self-attested copy of the application, certified copy of the order and original compromise on 27.07.2025 on which date, the court below shall put to notice the O.P.
no.2 and thereafter fix a date in the first week of August, 2025 for the verification and the same be done by 29.08.2025.
6. In view of aforesaid, the application stands disposed of.

7. Till the verification proceeding is completed, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants in Case No.6019 of 2019 (Smt. Anjula Maurya Vs. Ravi Prakash Maurya and others)
under section 323, 504, 506, 498A IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, police station Phoolpur, District Prayagraj,
pending in the court of Judicial Magistrate Court No.2, Allahabad as well as summoning order dated 05.03.2021 passed by Judicial Magistrate Court No.2 Allahabad.
